raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

External prefix-cache-aware routers cannot determine a group's prefix reuse policy from its attention kind alone. This PR exposes `prefix_cacheable` and `prefix_replay_tokens` from the resolved spec through `EngineCore.get_kv_cache_group_metadata()`.

## Claims

- Report whether each group participates in prefix caching and its required tail replay length.
- Cover KpoolTail, Sliding MLA with bounded replay on/off, and uniform-type wrappers in the existing CPU metadata suite.

## Validation

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q \
  tests/v1/engine/test_kv_cache_group_metadata.py
.venv/bin/ruff check vllm/v1/engine/core.py tests/v1/engine/test_kv_cache_group_metadata.py
.venv/bin/ruff format --check vllm/v1/engine/core.py tests/v1/engine/test_kv_cache_group_metadata.py
git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD
```

Result: **5 passed**, including the existing DCP effective-block-size test. Omitting the added fields caused all 4 new cases to fail with `KeyError: 'prefix_cacheable'`. Ruff and whitespace checks passed.

Validation ran in CPU mode with Python 3.12.3 and PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130. Model evaluation is not applicable to this metadata-only addition.

## Details

KpoolTail is classified as sliding-window attention but has `prefix_cacheable=False`. Bounded-replay Sliding MLA also opts out of shared prefix lookup and declares a replay window. These properties let external consumers identify participating groups and account for replay when estimating reuse benefits.

Related to [#48121](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48121), which expands canonical metadata and frontend access. Its current diff does not include these two prefix-policy properties; this PR adds only those fields to the existing RPC.

AI assistance was used to prepare the implementation and tests.

files.patch:
@@ -3,16 +3,20 @@
 
 from types import SimpleNamespace
 
+import msgspec
 import pytest
 import torch
 
 from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_manager import KVCacheManager
 from vllm.v1.engine.core import EngineCore
 from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    KpoolTailSpec,
     KVCacheConfig,
     KVCacheGroupSpec,
     MambaSpec,
     MLAAttentionSpec,
+    SlidingWindowMLASpec,
+    UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs,
 )
 
 pytestmark = pytest.mark.cpu_test
@@ -63,8 +67,55 @@ def test_kv_cache_group_metadata_uses_effective_dcp_block_sizes() -> None:
     # DCP scales attention blocks but does not scale replicated Mamba state.
     assert [item["block_size"] for item in metadata] == [12288, 1536]
     assert [item["kind"] for item in metadata] == ["mla_attention", "mamba"]
+    assert [item["prefix_cacheable"] for item in metadata] == [True, True]
+    assert [item["prefix_replay_tokens"] for item in metadata] == [0, 0]
 
     managers = engine_core.scheduler.kv_cache_manager.coordinator.single_type_managers
     assert [item["block_size"] for item in metadata] == [
         manager.block_size for manager in managers
     ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "spec_type,bounded_replay,wrapped,cacheable,replay_tokens",
+    [
+        pytest.param(KpoolTailSpec, False, False, False, 0, id="kpool-tail"),
+        pytest.param(SlidingWindowMLASpec, False, False, True, 0, id="sliding-mla"),
+        pytest.param(SlidingWindowMLASpec, True, False, False, 128, id="replay"),
+        pytest.param(SlidingWindowMLASpec, True, True, False, 128, id="wrapped-replay"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_kv_cache_group_metadata_reports_prefix_policy(
+    spec_type, bounded_replay, wrapped, cacheable, replay_tokens
+) -> None:
+    """The same attention kind can require a different prefix reuse policy."""
+    kwargs = dict(
+        block_size=16,
+        num_kv_heads=1,
+        head_size=64,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        sliding_window=128,
+    )
+    if spec_type is SlidingWindowMLASpec:
+        kwargs["bounded_replay"] = bounded_replay
+    spec = spec_type(**kwargs)
+    if wrapped:
+        spec = UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs(block_size=16, kv_cache_specs={"layer": spec})
+    engine_core = object.__new__(EngineCore)
+    engine_core.scheduler = SimpleNamespace(
+        kv_cache_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            kv_cache_groups=[KVCacheGroupSpec(["layer"], spec)]
+        ),
+        kv_cache_manager=SimpleNamespace(
+            coordinator=SimpleNamespace(
+                single_type_managers=[SimpleNamespace(block_size=16)]
+            )
+        ),
+    )
+
+    metadata = msgspec.msgpack.decode(
+        msgspec.msgpack.encode(engine_core.get_kv_cache_group_metadata())
+    )
+
+    assert metadata[0]["prefix_cacheable"] is cacheable
+    assert metadata[0]["prefix_replay_tokens"] == replay_tokens

@@ -474,7 +474,7 @@ def log_field(name: str, field: str) -> str:
             supported_pooling_tasks,
         )
 
-    def get_kv_cache_group_metadata(self) -> list[dict[str, int | str | None]]:
+    def get_kv_cache_group_metadata(self) -> list[dict[str, int | str | bool | None]]:
         """Return serializable KV cache metadata for external event consumers
         (e.g., Dynamo). This function has no call sites within vLLM but needs to
         be kept.
@@ -485,7 +485,7 @@ def get_kv_cache_group_metadata(self) -> list[dict[str, int | str | None]]:
 
         kv_cache_manager = cast(Any, self.scheduler).kv_cache_manager
         managers = kv_cache_manager.coordinator.single_type_managers
-        metadata: list[dict[str, int | str | None]] = []
+        metadata: list[dict[str, int | str | bool | None]] = []
         for group_idx, (group, manager) in enumerate(
             zip(kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups, managers, strict=True)
         ):
@@ -496,6 +496,8 @@ def get_kv_cache_group_metadata(self) -> list[dict[str, int | str | None]]:
                     "kind": get_kv_cache_spec_kind(spec).value,
                     "block_size": manager.block_size,
                     "sliding_window": getattr(spec, "sliding_window", None),
+                    "prefix_cacheable": spec.prefix_cacheable,
+                    "prefix_replay_tokens": spec.prefix_replay_tokens,
                 }
             )
         return metadata
